sinopsis.es: Filmada durante la estadía de Rogge en Estados Unidos, entre 1927 y 1928, la película recorre las calles de Hollywood, en Los Ángeles, para mostrarle al público brasileño los grandes estudios, los actores y actrices famosos, la cultura y las curiosidades locales.
sinopsis.en: Filmed during Rogge's stay in the United States between 1927 and 1928, the film explores the streets of Hollywood, Los Angeles, aiming to reveal to the Brazilian public the structures of the major film studios, famous actors and actresses, and local culture and curiosities. With a taste of contemporary cinema , this almost century-old film from Paraná state (in Brazil) demonstrates, behind its informative intertitles and peculiar portraits, the interest of businessman-turned-filmmaker Arthur Rogge in the development of a local film industry. (G.B.)
